NI0Wc-YMEN2V5gad9rS5mw.zh: 安吉拉(英國海外領土)報告1例25歲本土病例,近期無旅遊史,3/7出現發燒、頭痛、嘔吐、腹痛等症狀,並已住院治療,當局已採取相關防治措施。
NI0Wc-YMEN2V5gad9rS5mw.en: Anguilla, a British Overseas Territory, has reported one locally acquired case in a 25-year-old with no recent travel history. Symptoms of fever, headache, vomiting and abdominal pain began on 7 March; the patient has been hospitalized for treatment. Authorities have implemented relevant prevention and control measures.
